diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Friday 5 PM (weekly)"] --> RESCORE["🔁 Ingest [RESCORE] flags\nmis-scored stocks"]
  SCHED --> CLOSED["📋 Close trades >7d old\nWrite outcomes"]
  CLOSED --> STATS["📊 Compute stats\nwin rate, P&L, correlations"]
  STATS --> TOOLS["🤖 DeepSeek-reasoner tool loop\nsignals · correlations · macro"]
  RESCORE --> TOOLS
  TOOLS --> RAG["🔎 semantic_search_decisions\nvector recall of similar trades"]
  TOOLS --> HYP["💡 Write hypotheses"]
  HYP --> GATE{"10+ closed trades\n+ confidence gate?"}
  GATE -->|"No / Phase 0"| LOG["📝 Log only (read-only)"]
  GATE -->|"Yes"| CHALLENGER["⚖️ Create CHALLENGER\nin strategy_versions (immutable)"]
  CHALLENGER --> PROMOTE["👤 Human promotes via\nStrategy Registry → champion"]

SCHED.label: Friday 5 PM
SCHED.description: Weekly batch via Windows Task Scheduler (FridayTrigger 5 PM ET); the route gates on getDay()===5. Weekly avoids overfitting to noise.
SCHED.addReason: Weekly is the right learning cadence. Daily = overfit to noise.
SCHED.changeReason: Corrected schedule: runs FRIDAY 5 PM (Windows Scheduler), not Sunday 8 PM. Diagram was stale.

RESCORE.label: Ingest [RESCORE] flags
RESCORE.description: Reads [RESCORE] notes from learning_log written by the rescore-check job (weekday 4:45 PM) — stocks the research agent under/over-scored vs realized price. Feeds scoring-calibration learning.
RESCORE.addReason: Close the loop on scoring accuracy: revisit names where the score diverged from what actually happened.

CLOSED.label: Close trades >7d old
CLOSED.description: Closes paper_trades open >7 days, writes exit price, realized P&L, and outcome (win/loss/breakeven).
CLOSED.addReason: Learning requires ground truth — actual trade outcomes.

STATS.label: Compute stats
STATS.description: Win rate, avg return, per-dimension correlation with P&L, auto-guard check (3 runs <35% win → pause mutations).
STATS.addReason: Summary statistics needed before any weight proposal.

TOOLS.label: DeepSeek-reasoner tool loop
TOOLS.description: The learner is a true tool-use agent on deepseek-reasoner (NOT Opus — the app has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and the Claude CLI can't do tool-calling). Calls query_signals, query_score_correlation, query_macro_context, query_trade_decisions, read_priors.
TOOLS.addReason: An agent that reasons over tools evolves the strategy, vs a fixed script.
TOOLS.changeReason: Model changed from claude-opus-4-8 to deepseek-reasoner — Opus tool-loop failed (no API key). Cost ~$0.04/run.

RAG.label: semantic_search_decisions
RAG.description: Voyage voyage-finance-2 (1024-dim) vector search over enriched trade_decision_embeddings — finds semantically similar past trades regardless of ticker to surface shared failure modes.
RAG.addReason: Keyword/filter queries miss semantically-similar situations across different symbols/regimes.

HYP.label: Write hypotheses
HYP.description: Saves grounded findings (claim + evidence + confidence + category) to learning_log for future runs.
HYP.addReason: Hypotheses accumulate into the evidence base that eventually justifies weight changes.

GATE.label: Phase + confidence gate
GATE.description: Requires 10+ closed trades (Phase 1), per-dimension min_confidence, and no auto-guard trip before proposing a weight change. N<10 = Phase 0 log-only.
GATE.addReason: 10 trades is the minimum for statistical meaning; below that is noise.

LOG.label: Log only
LOG.description: Phase 0: writes analysis to learning_log, no weight changes. Builds the dataset.
LOG.addReason: Logging builds the evidence needed to eventually tune weights.

CHALLENGER.label: Create CHALLENGER
CHALLENGER.description: Does NOT mutate live weights. Inserts an immutable strategy_versions row (state=challenger) with a weights_snapshot of only the 5 weight columns. Errors are checked; version carries a date+HHMMSS suffix.
CHALLENGER.addReason: Governance gate: probabilistic learning must not silently overwrite the champion strategy.

PROMOTE.label: Human promotes
PROMOTE.description: A challenger only takes effect when the user promotes it to champion via the Strategy Registry (/dashboard/strategies). Human-in-the-loop before any live strategy change.
PROMOTE.addReason: Human review before learning changes live behavior.
